Name: Kirara Hoshi JJK NPC - Stardew Valley
Author: josiejjoestar
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Adds Kirara Hoshi from Jujutsu Kaisen to Pelican town as a custom NPC. She's her own character, and does not replace any other NPCs. She works really well with the other Jujutsu Kaisen mods, and has funny scenes and interactions with the usual Pelican Town residents as well![/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Features:[/size][/b][/color]
Four Heart Events - will definitely add more in the future!
Festivals - She comes to all of them and has a lot to say!
Ginger Island Attire - we know Kirara wouldn't be caught dead without a gorgeous island fit.
Movie Preferences - Invite her to the movies and buy her snacks, she's a great time.
Expanded Compatibility - She is meant to be compatible with SVE, let me know if you guys encounter any problems with this.
Pelliper Town Compatibility - Yeah I gave her Pokémon if you want to add her to your Pelliper Town save. I couldn't stand seeing her Pokémon-less. The instructions will be in a readme doc in her files. 

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
Install SMAPI:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
Install Content Patcher:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
Download Kirara Hoshi JJK NPC - Stardew Valley here
Unzip the file and drag the folder into your "Mods" folder 

The link below will help you get started adding mods to Stardew if this is your first one! Feel free to comment with any questions.
[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Stardew Modding Getting Started Wiki[/url]

I also highly recommend installing the Satoru Gojo mod by Cursedcure and my Megumi Fushiguro mod. She has some voice-lines mentioning them, so it's more fun if they're there too!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21209]Satoru Gojo[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48565]Megumi Fushiguro[/url]

[b]Pelliper Town Instructions[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50344]Pelliper Town Mod[/url]

Look inside the 'README PELLIPER TOWN' folder in Kirara's mod

Take the file in this folder "villager_companions" and copy it.

Go into your Pelliper Town "PelliperTown.Mod" folder.
Click the assets folder
Click the data folder
Paste the "villager_companions" file in there.
It will overwrite the one that already exists.

Now, the JJK NPCs will have a Pokémon!

[size=4][b]Kirara's Schedule[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8][b]She's roomies with Haley and Emily, so she'll always start there![/b][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Monday: [/b]Heads to the mines at 1000(10am) for her job (ew). Then goes and chills in the mountains and looks at the lake until she heads back to Haley's at 2200 (10pm).[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Tuesday: [/b]Goes to "train" in the town square by the big tree with Gojo and Megumi at 900 (9am). Leaves to go work out with the town girlies at 1200 (12pm). Goes back to do some more training at 1600 (4pm). Heads to the Saloon to help Emily at 1900 (7pm). Leaves for home at 2200 (10pm).[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Wednesday: [/b]Leaves home at 1000 (10am) to go hang out in town on the bench by the Mayor's house.  Heads to the Saloon at 2000 (8pm) to help Emily at work, then heads home at 2400 (midnight).[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Thursday:[/b] At 1000 (10am), heads to the forest by the big tree for some more "training." Then she goes to the Saloon 1800 (6pm) and returns home at 2400 (midnight).[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Friday: [/b]Leaves home at 1000 (10am) to go train by the big tree in the forest again. Then, she heads to the Saloon at 1600 (4pm) to mingle with the townsfolk, and leaves for home at 2400 (midnight).[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Saturday: [/b]Heads to the Museum at 1100 (11am) to "study." At 1800 (6pm) she heads to the saloon. She leaves for home at 2400 (midnight).[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Sunday:[/b] Heads to the Museum for some more studying at 1100 (11am). Leaves to go chill in town at the picnic table behind Pierre's at 1800 (6pm), and later heads home at 2200 (10pm).[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]4 Heart Event: Sunny Day in the Forest between 6pm and 11pm[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]6 Heart Event: Saloon between 5pm and 11pm[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]8 Heart Event: Saloon between 5pm and 11pm[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]10 Heart Event: Sunny Day in Town between 4pm and 10pm[/color]
